results.description:
A ring. A vow. Eight years of patient obsession. Now two morally gray billionaires finally claim the woman who was always meant to be theirs…
I’m the nightmare Houston’s elite whisper about—information broker, strategic gambler, and the man who’s been waiting eight years to collect what belongs to me.
Sophie Langford, the fiery woman who tried to run away with the wrong man. The woman I saved from her own naive heart, then watched from the shadows as she built walls no ordinary man could breach.
But I’m not ordinary. And neither is my partner.
Caleb Pierce reads people like others read headlines—every tell, every weakness, every secret desire.
Sophie thinks she’s untouchable behind her carefully constructed wall of independence. She has no idea we’ve orchestrated the perfect trap. All roads lead back to us.
And she’s about to discover that some men don’t ask for trust—they take everything.
Theirs to Tempt is a dark, sinful standalone in the Titans Billionaires secret society world. It features two obsessed, morally gray billionaires, a financial adviser heroine, a marriage she doesn’t want, age gap, innocent heroine, forced proximity, eight years of patient obsession, and the ultimate “we’ve been waiting for you” energy.
Because some debts can only be paid in surrender.
